contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---] VS PF AVG ; R/ [VICTORIAE] DD NN AVG ET CAES

Copper alloy coin. Probably a Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius (350-353), small module copy of Two Victories, issue of 351-353, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust with pudding basin haircut draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---] VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories holding wreath inscribed VOT/V/MVLT/X. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE] DD NN AVG ET CAES.…
